help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives this power a chance to grant you a small regeneration and endurance discount bonus and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This regeneration and endurance discount buff stacks up to 5 times.  This effect will trigger roughly 6 times per minute.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Brutes and may be slotted into any Brute damage power.
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate, Chance for +Regen/+End Discount
